Docs.summary: Obsolete backward-compatibility stub for the billing-account scoped consumption resource that existed in the v1.1.0 surface. The TypeSpec migration replaced the wrapper resource with scope-based extension methods on ; this type now throws on every member and is hidden from IntelliSense. Use the scope-based extension methods on (for example GetConsumptionBalanceResults(scope), GetConsumptionEventSummaries(scope, ...), GetConsumptionLotSummaries(scope, ...), GetConsumptionReservationTransactions(scope, ...)) instead.
